notes: Unresolved: (1) Axis Bank's Brigade Magnum office could not be corroborated, and the Thought Factory lab's address was not found, so that office stays low. (2) Amelia's ITPB Voyager office is IPsoft-era, and SoundHound's Feb 2026 Bengaluru hub has no published address. (3) Broadcom's Electronics City Phase 1 pin is still the phase centroid because no plot was identified; the RMZ Ecospace record was not re-fetched. (4) The Aequs Tower building did not geocode, so its pin is the Mahadevapura locality point. (5) Agratas' Bengaluru R&D centre is company-confirmed, but only OSM places it at Prestige Tech Cloud. (6) The Adobe POIs: which of the two OSM nodes is Platina and which is Tech Park IV was not checked against a building footprint. (7) Archwell was dropped because no source beyond one OSM node exists and the Lennar parentage and website were wrong. A reviewer with MCA21 access could reinstate it if a real CIN turns up. Broadcom's offices-page URL returned 404.
